LightningComponentBundle.description: Dynamic add/remove list of Ticket Type rows (Name/Price/Quota/Description) with a running quota-vs-venue-capacity preview. Drop into a Screen Flow screen in place of the Add_Ticket_Type/Add_Another_Ticket_Type Go-To loop from event-creation-flow.md.

property.name: venueCapacity
property.label: Venue Capacity
property.description: Selected venue's capacity, used only for the running-total preview. Bind to Get_Selected_Venue_Capacity's Venue_Capacity__c output.

property.name: ticketTypes
property.label: Ticket Types
property.description: The ticket types the organizer entered. Bind to a Flow collection variable of Apex-Defined type TicketTypeWrapper (Allow multiple values: on).

property.name: runningQuotaTotal
property.label: Running Quota Total
property.description: Live sum of all ticket type quotas entered so far, if a later screen (e.g. Review) wants to display it.
